factual_transfer_risks: Prompt Hub examples can leak domain facts into unrelated tasks if copied literally.
Adversarial prompt examples must be test stimuli, not behavior templates.
weak_example_risks: Poorly matched examples may overfit response shape or create false factual assumptions.
Expansion pressure may weaken no-example-over-weak-example rule.
injection_controller_updates_needed: Prompt Hub examples cannot define runtime policy.
Adversarial examples must stay in eval/safety test surfaces.
catalog_boundary_risks: Catalog must not own selection logic.
Catalog must not own factual authority.
Catalog must not override source-of-truth safety/tool/retrieval rules.
